sample_unit: patients with prostate cancer (8158 slides, 18,761 lymph nodes)

links.outcome: AUROC of model trained at one centre and externally validated at four other centres
links.effect: AUROC ranged from 0.975 (0.953-0.998) to 0.992 (0.982-1.000) in training and validation datasets, sensitivities >0.955 and specificities >0.921; cross-cancer AUROC 0.979.
links.quote: The AUROC of ProCaLNMD ranged from 0.975 (95% confidence interval 0.953-0.998) to 0.992 (0.982-1.000) in the training and validation datasets, with sensitivities > 0.955 and specificities > 0.921.

links.outcome: AI sensitivity compared with junior and senior pathologists on the same data
links.effect: AI sensitivity 0.983 exceeded two junior pathologists (0.862, P=0.023; 0.879, P=0.041) by 10-12% and matched two senior pathologists (both 0.983).
links.quote: In the human-AI comparison and collaboration study, the sensitivity of ProCaLNMD (0.983 [0.908-1.000]) surpassed that of two junior pathologists (0.862 [0.746-0.939], P = 0.023; 0.879 [0.767-0.950], P = 0.041) by 10-12% and showed no difference to that of two senior pathologists (both 0.983 [0.908-1.000], both P > 0.99).

screen.reason: The study evaluated human-AI collaboration (reader study) comparing pathologists' standalone performance and review time versus pathologists assisted by the AI tool.
